name: @science-studio/molql-tool-openclaw
description: OpenClaw gateway plugin registering the `molql` (viewer selection) and `computeInteraction` (non-covalent interactions) tools for Science Studio.

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:install: openclaw plugins uninstall molql-tool && npm run plugin:build && node scripts/install.mjs && openclaw plugins enable molql-tool --accept-capabilities
